QuestInfo.name: [Maple Leaf High] Martial Arts Academy Director
QuestInfo.0: So Gong recommended Mu Gong, who was once the director of the Mu Lung Martial Arts Academy, to be the new principal of Maple Leaf High.
QuestInfo.1: So Gong wants you to test out Mu Gong in the Principal's Office.
QuestInfo.2: You battled Mu Gong's qualifications for the title of principal!
